criteria.1.1: 1.1 WHEN MUG-01 has stock 5 and cart A has reserved 3 units THEN the system lets cart B reserve 3 more units with no `OutOfStock`
criteria.1.2: 1.2 WHEN MUG-01 has stock 5 and cart A has reserved 3 units and cart B reserves 3 units THEN the system returns -1 from `available("MUG-01")`
criteria.1.3: 1.3 WHEN MUG-01 has stock 5 and one cart adds 3 units two times THEN the system accepts the second add with no `OutOfStock`
criteria.2.1: 2.1 WHEN MUG-01 has stock 5 and cart A has reserved 3 units THE SYSTEM SHALL raise `OutOfStock` for a reserve of 3 more units by cart B
criteria.2.2: 2.2 WHEN MUG-01 has stock 5 and cart A has reserved 3 units and cart B tries to reserve 3 units THE SYSTEM SHALL return 2 from `available("MUG-01")`
criteria.2.3: 2.3 WHEN MUG-01 has stock 5 and one cart adds 3 units two times THE SYSTEM SHALL raise `OutOfStock` for the second add
criteria.3.1: 3.1 WHEN no units of a sku are reserved and one reserve asks for more units than its stock THE SYSTEM SHALL CONTINUE TO raise `OutOfStock`
criteria.3.2: 3.2 WHEN a reserve asks for 0 or fewer units THE SYSTEM SHALL CONTINUE TO raise `ValueError`
criteria.3.3: 3.3 WHEN `release` runs with any number of units THE SYSTEM SHALL CONTINUE TO return at most the initial stock from `available`
criteria.3.4: 3.4 WHEN `Cart.remove` runs for a sku in the cart THE SYSTEM SHALL CONTINUE TO raise `available` by the qty of that line
criteria.3.5: 3.5 WHEN the running total of reserves for a sku stays at or below its stock THE SYSTEM SHALL CONTINUE TO accept each reserve
criteria.3.6: 3.6 WHEN `Cart.add` raises `OutOfStock` THE SYSTEM SHALL CONTINUE TO leave the lines of that cart unchanged
criteria.3.7: 3.7 WHEN an add through `POST /carts/<id>/lines` raises `OutOfStock` THE SYSTEM SHALL CONTINUE TO return status 409
